samples.question: A vertical timeline of five panels reads top to bottom. Each panel shows a single horizontal signal bar that is either ON (filled dark) or OFF (empty). A magenta ring beside the first (top) panel marks a bit whose starting state is shown there: a filled interior means the bit starts ON, an empty interior means it starts OFF. The bit's state changes only when the signal makes a rising edge, meaning the signal is OFF in one panel and ON in the next panel; otherwise the bit keeps its current state. Reading the panels in order, what is the final state of the ringed bit at the last (bottom) panel? Answer 'ON' or 'OFF'.
